legacy_migration.trigger: A locked rapid two-person exchange occurs in one stable place and later includes one or more terminal physical occupancy changes
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Register both bodies/table/sides once, use stable opposing singles while face/hand states change, return to shared geometry when the first occupancy change needs relational proof, and allow a later isolated single to carry the second body's own occupancy change when its path remains readable
legacy_migration.coverage: opening pair master → alternating fixed-side singles → shared first occupancy change → isolated second-body state and occupancy change
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock seat IDs, table edge, screen sides, foreground shoulder logic and each required movement direction; background patrons stay secondary
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Do not cut by a fixed line quota; preserve the master when geography changes and let single durations follow locked body/strategy states
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK; no dialogue overlap, pause, bar ambience or sound-led cut is prescribed
legacy_migration.applicability: Stable two-person negotiation, breakup, interview or argument where geography is simple and only one or more late body moves change the spatial state
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Impossible/subjective space replaces room geography, additional participants independently act, hands/objects carry the main causal proof, or both bodies move continuously
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Opening master is too brief to register sides; singles flip; return master adds no new state; either occupancy change occurs off-screen; the isolated second-body shot implies an unverified emotion

legacy_migration.fallback: Project-original locked two-shot plus two fixed singles; no moving crowd; return to the two-shot for the first complete stand/turn/exit, then use one fixed second-person medium that may include a separately locked rise/move if the script requires it
